author: Jeff Geerling
description:
I put a computer in your computer. And on your computer. And behind your computer.

Links to all the KVMs I mentioned (in order of appearance):

  - PiKVM: https://pikvm.org
  - BliKVM: https://blikvm.com
  - GL-iNet Comet/Pro/etc: https://www.gl-inet.com/products/gl-rm1/
  - Sipeed NanoKVM/Pro/etc: https://wiki.sipeed.com/hardware/en/kvm/NanoKVM/introduction.html
  - JetKVM: https://jetkvm.com
  - Luckfox: https://www.luckfox.com/Luckfox-PicoKVM-Base
  - LeafKVM: https://kvm.rs
  - TinyPilot: https://tinypilotkvm.com
  - Openterface KVM-GO: https://openterface.com
  - Pi-Cast: https://www.crowdsupply.com/hackergadgets/pi-cast-kvm
  - DezKVM: https://www.tindie.com/products/tobychui/dezkvm-go-kvm-over-usb-device/

Thanks to all the KVM manufacturers who sent in review units over the past couple years, many of which were displayed in this video. (Note: None of the companies paid anything for this video, or had any say in its contents.)

Support me on Patreon: https://www.patreon.com/ge
title: I tested EVERY single IP KVM
